command:
set -eu
echo FORMATS_BEGIN
cat /proc/uptime
for p in /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/events/sdpsoc/sdp_mem_ioctl/format /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/events/sdpsoc/sdp_mem_dbg/format /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/events/sdpsoc/sdp_hwmem_ioctl/format /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/events/sdpsoc/sdp_hwmem_dbg/format /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/events/user/user/format /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/events/printk/console/format; do
echo "FORMAT $p"
cat "$p"
done
echo FORMATS_END
